| Gain 2 | Gain 1 = 1 | Gain 1 = 0.5 | Gain 1 = 0.25 | Gain 1 = 0 |

The PSNR in dB against the clean disks, for the disks with Gaussian noise of sigma 15, 24.77 dB before the filter. Gain 3 and gain 4 stay 1. Gains of 1 everywhere give the noisy image back. Lowering gain 1 to 0.5 or 0.25 removes much of the noise, since most of it sits in the finest level. Gain 1 at 0, or a lower gain 2, also takes away part of the edges of the disks, so the PSNR falls again.
